title: Does pushing the safety vector harder break capability before it breaks compliance?

original_idea.body: Sweep refusal-vector strength; measure harmful-refusal, benign over-refusal, and capability (MMLU subset) to find a safe operating window; three-curve plot.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a safe-operating-window curve informs whether safety steering is deployable (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Strength sweep with three curves on one open model; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (three-curve plot, safe window) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public model, externally runnable dose-response study (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference sweep + small benchmark, no training; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Side-effect work exists; explicit three-way window partly open; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Three-curve safe-window framing may be partly open.
